- **Brown Stem Rot**: Internal pith browning, interveinal chlorosis — no match

- **Soybean Rust**: Leaf spots, field defoliation — no match
- **Downy Mildew**: Leaf symptoms with fuzzy growth — no match

- **BPMV / SDMV**: Leaf mosaic/mottle, no stem structures — no match
- **Soybean Cyst Nematode**: Root/field-level yellowing — no match

The bleached white stems with scattered black pycnidia are the hallmark of **Diaporthe** (Pod and Stem Blight) at late season.
